title: Implement authentication (WebAuthn + password with session tokens)
description: Authentication system supporting WebAuthn and password login, issuing session tokens with expiry, rate limiting failed attempts.
acceptance_criteria: POST /auth/login with valid password + email returns 200 with session token
POST /auth/login with invalid password returns 401 after 5 attempts, rate-limited for 15 min
POST /auth/webauthn/verify verifies assertion and returns session token
Session token expires in 24h, returned in Set-Cookie with HttpOnly + Secure flags
GET /auth/me with valid token returns user info
Password hashed with bcrypt (cost factor 12), never stored in plaintext
Password never appears in logs or error messages
privacy_invariants: Auth events logged for 90 days
No PII in error messages

title: Implement in-app notifications (local event queue, no push)

acceptance_criteria: POST /notifications creates notification with: id, user_id, type, title, body, created_at, read=false
GET /notifications returns unread notifications for user, sorted by created_at desc
PATCH /notifications/{id} with {read: true} marks as read
Notification types: info, warning, error, success, approval_request
No external delivery (no email, push, SMS) in Phase 1
security_invariants: User can only see their own notifications
privacy_invariants: Notification content not sent to any external service

title: Implement retry with exponential backoff and jitter
description: A retry utility for transient failures with configurable max attempts, exponential backoff, jitter, and circuit breaker integration.
acceptance_criteria: retry(fn, {maxAttempts: 3}) calls fn at most 3 times
Backoff: attempt N waits baseDelay * 2^(N-1) + random(0, jitterMs) ms
Non-retryable errors (e.g. 400 Bad Request) do NOT trigger retry
Circuit breaker opens after 5 consecutive failures, blocks for 60s
Circuit breaker half-open: allows 1 probe request after cooldown
All retry attempts logged with attempt number, delay, error
RetryExhausted error includes last error and attempt count
security_invariants: Retry does not replay non-idempotent operations without idempotency key
privacy_invariants: Error details in logs do not include request body

title: Implement skill registry and loader (local YAML loading)

listSkills() returns array of skill names

reloadSkills() re-reads directory and updates cache
Skill definitions cannot execute code (declarative only in Phase 1)

privacy_invariants: Skill loading does not access user data

title: Implement secrets broker (local vault with encrypted SQLite)

GET /vault/secrets/{name} returns decrypted value only with valid capability token
Secrets encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM using master key derived from user password
Master key never stored in plaintext (derived via PBKDF2, 100k iterations)
All access logged: timestamp, secret_name, requester, grant/deny
Secret values never appear in logs
List /vault/secrets returns names only, never values
security_invariants: Master key never persisted in plaintext
privacy_invariants: Secret access audit log retained 90 days
rollback_or_compensation: Delete compromised secret, revoke all access tokens

Health check always returns healthy without network
